e5072675a32f56de310b431c2ef8f72944776c33.summary: The report explains WastedLocker, a targeted ransomware first reported hitting organisations in May 2020 and attributed to the Evil Corp group, known for the Dridex botnet. Ransom demands reportedly ranged from $500,000 to $10 million, and most victims were US organisations. The infection chain reportedly starts with the SocGholish framework delivered as fake browser updates, followed by Cobalt Strike, credential theft and lateral movement. Files are encrypted with AES and RSA, and shadow copies and backups are targeted. Garmin was a prominent victim in July.
